product_images_public.name: product_images_public
product_images_public.using: exists (select 1 from public.stores s where s.id = store_id and s.published_at is not null) and exists (select 1 from public.products p where p.id = product_id and p.archived_at is null)

product_variants_public.name: product_variants_public
product_variants_public.using: exists (select 1 from public.stores s where s.id = store_id and s.published_at is not null) and archived_at is null and exists (select 1 from public.products p where p.id = product_id and p.archived_at is null)

products_public.name: products_public
products_public.using: exists (select 1 from public.stores s where s.id = store_id and s.published_at is not null) and archived_at is null

store_slugs_public.name: store_slugs_public
store_slugs_public.using: exists (select 1 from public.stores s where s.id = store_id and s.published_at is not null)

stores_app_select.name: stores_app_select
stores_app_select.using: id = (select nullif(current_setting('app.store_id', true), '')::uuid) or owner_user_id = (select nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))

stores_app_update.name: stores_app_update
stores_app_update.using: id = (select nullif(current_setting('app.store_id', true), '')::uuid) or owner_user_id = (select nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))
stores_app_update.withCheck: id = (select nullif(current_setting('app.store_id', true), '')::uuid) or owner_user_id = (select nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))
